Carmen: Heads-up  new Senior Infra ML starts Mon 9am PT. Need a compact week0 heatmap + a friendly candidate one-pager and a manager 30/60/90 checklist. Devon, can you coordinate buddy + IT?
Devon: Sure. Buddy = Asha mornings. IT says laptop can ship Fri if I confirm asset tag today. I'll open GH + k8s tickets.
Asha: I can do 9:15-9:45 pairing weekdays for first 2 weeks. I'll prepare a "first-48h" checklist and a short screencast for running tests.
Carmen: Great. I'm thinking of a slightly different format: a week0 heatmap (blocks of time showing live vs async), a candidate one-pager that fits the offer email, and a manager-facing 30/60/90 with explicit acceptance criteria + a short feedback rubric.
Devon: sounds useful. IT/infra needs to pre-provision: laptop image + asset tag, Okta, Slack, GitHub org + repo write, CI access, k8s namespace + canary-only SA, read-only prod metrics, and Redwood Console dev role.
infra-bot: Ticket created: #12098 (laptop image, Okta, GH invite, k8s ns). Owner: infra-team.
Carmen: Week0 heatmap (remote-first, concise):
```
Mon AM (live): 20m welcome call + account handoff; 30m buddy pairing to get dev env green
Mon PM (async): repo links, recorded demos, access links, NDA link if required
Tue (live): 60m codebase walkthrough with owner (pairing)
Wed (mixed): 30m observability walk + 30m security/NDA check (live)
Thu (live): 45m deploy and canary demo + 20m smoke run with buddy
Fri (live): 30m manager sync + 15m buddy retro + plan for week2 (async doc)
```
Carmen: Candidate one-pager (single short paragraph for the offer email):
"Welcome aboard! In your first 30 days we expect your dev environment ready and 12 small PRs merged; by 60 days youll own a non-peak deploy and take part in at least one incident review; by 90 days youll be independently deploying, leading a short tech sync, and proposing a measurable perf or cost improvement. Your buddy is Asha (morning pairing); manager is Carmen; infra owner is Devon. Please sign the NDA (link) to unlock dataset access and any gated model weights."
Asha: I'll add the screencast and a short "how to run tests" checklist to the onboarding doc and calendar invites.
Carmen: Manager-facing 30/60/90 (with acceptance criteria + feedback rubric):
30 days:
- Acceptance criteria: dev env green, 2 small PRs merged (one code change with tests, one doc), can run core tests locally/CI, buddy feedback submitted
- Manager action: schedule weekly 1:1, daily 15m check-ins in week0, brief formative note at day 30
60 days:
- Acceptance criteria: owns one service deploy in a non-peak window (canary flow), can reproduce and debug a simple incident using runbook, contributes a ticket improving observability or test coverage
- Manager action: mid-60d feedback session, add incremental ownership in deploy runbook, recommend further learning sprints
90 days:
- Acceptance criteria: independent deploys, leads a 20m tech sync presenting a proposed perf/cost improvement with metrics, has a plan for next quarter mapped to service OKRs
- Manager action: 90d review + promotion of medium-term goals, update role expectations if needed
Carmen: Feedback rubric (short): 
- Green: meets acceptance criteria with minimal guidance
- Yellow: meets criteria but needs frequent manager/buddy support; has clear remediation plan
- Red: struggles to meet criteria; schedule focused coaching + escalate to hiring manager for decisions
Devon: Also include sample micro-task acceptance criteria for week0 so managers and buddies are aligned. Example: "fix README test command so CI passes" -> PR must include updated README, CI green in <1h, and reviewer sign-off from buddy.
legal-bot: NDA required for dataset/model-weight access. Link will be added to candidate email template.
people-ops-bot: Onboarding packet stub created: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/1870004321 (includes heatmap + one-pager + manager 30/60/90).
Carmen: One last thing  include a 1-line "first-week expectations for manager" blurb in the manager doc: daily 15m standups for blockers (week0), three micro-tasks assigned with explicit acceptance criteria, end-of-week 30m review, and a mid-30d formative check.
Asha: ack. Ill confirm buddy invites and attach the screencast + first-48h checklist.
Devon: Opening infra tickets now and will tag the canary-only deploy role. Will DM Carmen with asset tag once ticket is ready.
Carmen: Thanks team  please post the final files here for a quick sign-off by EOD and then hiring manager will send to the candidate. :thumbsup:
